name: Orshot
description: Automate video, PDF and image generation from templates and social media posting from OpenClaw. One install adds the hosted Orshot MCP server (OAuth, no API key) and the Orshot skills: render images, PDFs and video from your templates, schedule and publish posts to Instagram, LinkedIn, X, TikTok and 9 more, build carousels, and design social media content templates. No bundled code.
